title: R25 larger fused classical kernels: bounded audit
scope_owner: R25 engineering/scaling audit; any performance promotion remains a separate decision
accepted_scope: Static all-input classical DIT regrouping and exact-integer congruence argument
Exact online payload operation counts for every partition of the unchanged graph
Conservative magnitude-bit ceilings and derived coefficient-storage counts
Integrity and arithmetic consistency of supplied benchmark and validation records
not_established: Independent submitted-code execution or performance replication

decisive_boundary.domain: Unchanged, unpruned classical DIT graph with any grouping of all g=log2(N) levels
decisive_boundary.conclusion: Larger blocks or fewer remainders alone cannot lower the total scalar arithmetic below order N log N for this graph.

important_limits: No completed performance evidence at N=262144; 45-second limit was for the command, not a measured transform.
Largest exact suite tests boundary q=4, boundary q=6, products q=4 and growing q=5; it does not test q=8 at N=262144.
Author clean replay excludes benchmarks, exploration and separate large-width measurements.
Prepared samples overlap; q=8 is slower on cold calls. No independent process-level confidence or optimized-library comparison.
The executable caps q at 8; fixed field 998244353 supports power-of-two root orders only through 2^23.
